description: Let go and prioritize self control #selflove #selfconfidence #selfcontrol
transcript: Letting go of control is such a gift because nothing ever stays where it started. When I began releasing control, I made more room. I made more room for openness. I made more room to release judgment. I made more room for me to be me in its fullest form. I do not try to dictate the external world. It's not my job. The external world does not belong to me. The only thing that I am in control of is my internal world, my movements, my actions, my thoughts. Let go, move on, and release control.
